item.title: Eye on the Trail: Wind
item.description: Wind was a force throughout Iditarod 54. While you can’t take a picture of the wind, the force of the wind can be seen through the flags suspended over the burled arch. Thanks to Siri Raitto photo’s, we can see the wind velocity on Front Street in Nome from Jessie Holmes to Richie Beattie.
